name: music
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one transparent desktop UI app icon. Edit target: the supplied original iPod nano seventh generation music icon from Apple's guide. Preserve the original circular shape, original symbol, color family, subtle glossy highlight across the upper half, front-facing composition and original proportions. No text, no label, no extra objects, no perspective, no device mockup, no external shadows, no new design embellishments. Preserve the original icon's identity; do not invent a different symbol. True transparent background outside the circle.
reference: Apple iPod nano User Guide, page 5
